notes: Upcoming releases finally fills in: SideCut reads the announced dates straight from the artist’s own open catalog, where a pre-order carries its real day weeks before it lands — that catalog is read by the artist’s ID, not by the popularity-ranked search that was burying a dated drop.

Nothing to connect and nothing to verify anywhere: the Spotify pass and its silent token are gone from the release check, so no drop date is ever read through an account. The artist’s open catalog and MusicBrainz do all the finding.

A pinned artist’s upcoming release is looked up directly: one artist search for the ID, one album pass for the catalog, and every dated future release it lists flows through the same artwork, track-count and duplicate rules as everything else.
The release check reads a wider net of the same open sources, so a drop listed weeks out shows under Upcoming releases instead of only appearing on the day it lands.
This release changes nothing about how a drop you add by hand is stored — manual drops still carry their day and time.
